# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_STRUCTURE_REVERSAL_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A midday shift in market structure from higher‑highs to lower‑highs, coupled with weak momentum (RSI<40) and low volume (below 20-period average), indicates a loss of buying interest and offers a short opportunity. This edge exists because the change of character (BOS) to downside after 11:30 ET, when the morning trend has often exhausted, can capture the beginning of a new downward leg without the noise of the first 30 minutes.

## Mechanism

Entry: After 11:30 ET, if the most recent swing point creates a lower high (LH) while the prior swing was a higher high (HH) – i.e., a change of character (BOS) to downside – and RSI(14) < 40, enter short at the close of the bar that registers the LH, provided volume on that bar is below the 20‑period average (indicating lack of buying interest).  
Exit: Stop placed at the recent swing high (the LH level); target set at the prior swing low or at 1× risk (ATR‑based), with a runner trailed using a chandelier exit (ATR×2) after reaching 1× risk.
